item.title: Banyan Tree’s First Residential Tower in the U.S. Is Landing in West Palm Beach
item.description: Banyan Tree's U.S. debut in West Palm Beach, Florida, includes 88 homes designed around wellness and indoor-outdoor living, starting at $1.9 million.

item.title: United Airlines Is Adding Even More Luxe, Lie-Back Seats to Its New Planes
item.description: United Airlines's new fleet will include its Coastliner planes, which offer up new lie-flat premium seating courtesy of its next-gen Polaris suites.

item.title: You’ll Need an Invite to Score One of Rolls-Royce’s New Coachbuild Collection Cars
item.description: Rolls-Royce has announced a new program called the Coachbuild Collection. Each ultra-exclusive vehicle will be street-legal worldwide.

item.title: Alles, was Sie über private Schließfächer wissen müssen
item.description: Trisor, Asservato und Co: Durch Tresoreinbrüche in Banken steigt die Nachfrage nach privaten Schließfächern. Doch wie sicher sind die Anbieter wirklich?

item.title: Lee Marvin’s Former 5-Acre Estate in Tucson Just Listed for $5.75 Million
item.description: Designed by Josias Joesler, the Oscar winner’s former home been carefully restored with modern upgrades while preserving its original character.

item.title: LeBron James Decked Out His Fitness Tracker With a Hand-Painted Basketball Charm
item.description: LeBron James has tricked out his trusty Whoop fitness tracker with a hand-painted, basketball-shaped charm by London-based brand Poubel.

item.title: This $10.8 Million D.C. Mansion Makes You Neighbors With the Vice President
item.description: A historic Albert S.J. Atkinson-designed mansion in D.C., known as Heurich-Parks House, lists for $10.8 million with an indoor swimming pool.

item.title: Buffalo Trace’s Latest Weller Bourbon Is Made Using a Very Unusual Type of Wheat
item.description: Buffalo Trace's newest release is part of the Daniel Weller lineup, a wheated bourbon made using a very unusual wheat called spelt wheat.

item.title: This 350-Acre Montana Ranch Starred in ‘Yellowstone.’ Now It Can Be Yours for $16.3 Million.
item.description: Known as Two Feathers Ranch, the 357-acre property near Darby was originally part of Chief Joseph Ranch, where the hit Paramount TV show was filmed.

item.title: Ocean Alexander Just Unveiled Two New Superyachts With Enviable Sundecks and Pools
item.description: Ocean Alexander has added two models to the Puro line. The new 30P and 40P share the same design DNA as the existing 35P but have different features.

item.title: This New N.Y.C. Car Show Celebrates Modern Classics to Attract a New Generation of Collectors
item.description: Wheels of NYC catalogs the diverse, passionate car scene in the Big Apple.

item.title: The Bay Area Home Where Francis Ford Coppola Wrote ‘The Godfather’ Wants You to Make an Offer
item.description: The $6.8 million Mill Valley estate was home to the Oscar-winning filmmaker from 1970 until the early 1980s and is where he wrote "The Godfather."

item.title: Laura Attanasio: „Ab einer Million steigen so gut wie alle aus”
item.description: Als Vice President leitet Laura Attanasio die Pace Gallery in Berlin. Ein Gespräch über die Herausforderungen des Kunstmarkts und die Rolle Deutschlands darin.

item.title: Cayenne Electric: Der stärkste Porsche fährt elektrisch
item.description: Der neue Cayenne Electric ist das schnellste Serienfahrzeug, das Porsche je gebaut hat – und beweist, dass Leistung auch mit Strom geht.

item.title: Neo Frame: Audemars Piguet setzt auf Springende Stunde
item.description: Mit seiner neuen Uhr Neo Frame Springende Stunde zitiert Audemars Piguet die Vergangenheit – weil es die jüngsten Kunden so lieben.
